composition.raw_value: 80 mL ethanol, 60 mL nanopure water and 140 mL n-hexane

operation.raw_value: Dissolve iron(III) chloride hexahydrate in ethanol and nanopure water in a 500 mL three-neck round-bottom flask.
operation.normalized_value: Dissolve iron(III) chloride hexahydrate in ethanol and nanopure water in a 500 mL three-neck round-bottom flask.

operation.raw_value: Quickly add sodium oleate together with n-hexane and stir until the sodium oleate is completely dissolved.
operation.normalized_value: Quickly add sodium oleate together with n-hexane and stir until the sodium oleate is completely dissolved.

operation.raw_value: Heat the reaction solution at 70 °C for a 4 h reflux under a nitrogen blanket.
operation.normalized_value: Heat the reaction solution at 70 °C for a 4 h reflux under a nitrogen blanket.

operation.raw_value: Cool the reaction solution to room temperature.
operation.normalized_value: Cool the reaction solution to room temperature.

operation.raw_value: Separate the upper organic layer containing iron oleate and wash it three times with 30 mL nanopure water in a separatory funnel.
operation.normalized_value: Separate the upper organic layer containing iron oleate and wash it three times with 30 mL nanopure water in a separatory funnel.

operation.raw_value: Concentrate the iron oleate by rotary evaporation.
operation.normalized_value: Concentrate the iron oleate by rotary evaporation.

operation.raw_value: Transfer to a 100 mL round-bottom flask connected to a Schlenk line and place under vacuum overnight.
operation.normalized_value: Transfer to a 100 mL round-bottom flask connected to a Schlenk line and place under vacuum overnight.
